mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.8% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 3.8%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.35 million units signals strong household demand and rising inflationary pressure, which triggers monetary tightening expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1350.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 103.0 indicates weakening real economic activity and falling corporate earnings momentum, which reduces equity risk premiums and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 103.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in both real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based demand surge that accelerates inflation and triggers aggressive monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST rise simultaneously, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% combined with a federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates a lagged monetary policy response, creating a disinflationary risk premium that supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5 and FEDFUNDS is below 4.5, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals a labor market overheating that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.5% annualized growth, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 exceeds 2.5% and HOUST is rising, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
